[short] skip 'Verify a full configuration for the OKD 5.0 payload'

# Embed a config with all the fields (except olmOperators, which requires the
# authenticated redhat-operator-index catalog) and build the ISO from an OKD payload.
exec iso-config-embedder embed -c config.yaml -o $WORK/openshift-iso-builder-patched $ISO_BUILDER_BIN_RAW
stderr 'Configuration embedded into'

exec $WORK/openshift-iso-builder-patched build --log-level=debug
stderr 'Configuration loaded: version=5.0.0 arch=x86_64'
exists agent.x86_64.iso

exists auth/pull-secret.json
grep '^\{"auths":\{"":\{"auth":"dXNlcjpwYXNz"\}\}\}$' auth/pull-secret.json

exists tools/oc
exists tools/oc-mirror

# The manifests in the ISO reference the release image by digest, while the config only has
# a tag. Resolve the digest now, so that the expected files do not hardcode it.
setreleaseimage RELEASE_IMAGE quay.io/okd/scos-release:5.0.0-okd-scos.8

isocmp agent.x86_64.iso /etc/assisted/manifests/infraenv.yaml expected/infraenv.yaml
isocmp agent.x86_64.iso /etc/assisted/manifests/cluster-image-set.yaml expected/cluster-image-set.yaml
isocmp agent.x86_64.iso /etc/assisted/manifests/pull-secret.yaml expected/pull-secret.yaml
isocmp agent.x86_64.iso /etc/assisted/manifests/nmstateconfig.yaml expected/nmstateconfig.yaml

isocmpregex agent.x86_64.iso /etc/assisted/rendezvous-host.env expected/rendezvous-host.env

isoFileCmpRegEx agent.x86_64.iso /EFI/centos/grub.cfg expected/grub.cfg

-- config.yaml --
openshiftVersion: 5.0.0
releaseImageURL: quay.io/okd/scos-release:5.0.0-okd-scos.8
pullSecret: '{"auths":{"":{"auth":"dXNlcjpwYXNz"}}}'
architecture: x86_64
sshKey:
  - ssh-rsa 
fips: true
rendezvousIP: 192.168.122.80
additionalTrustBundle: |
  -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
  MIIDExample
  -----END CERTIFICATE-----
additionalNTPServers:
  - ntp1.example.com
  - ntp2.example.com
additionalImages:
  - quay.io/libpod/alpine:latest
networkConfig:
  - interfaces:
      - name: eth0
        macAddress: "52:54:00:aa:bb:01"
    config:
      interfaces:
        - name: eth0
          type: ethernet
          state: up
          mac-address: "52:54:00:aa:bb:01"
          ipv4:
            enabled: true
            address:
              - ip: 192.168.122.80
                prefix-length: 24
            dhcp: false

-- expected/infraenv.yaml --
apiVersion: agent-install.openshift.io/v1beta1
kind: InfraEnv
metadata:
  name: appliance
spec:
  additionalNTPSources:
  - ntp1.example.com
  - ntp2.example.com
  additionalTrustBundle: |
    -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
    MIIDExample
    -----END CERTIFICATE-----
  cpuArchitecture: x86_64
  ipxeScriptType: ""
  nmStateConfigLabelSelector:
    matchLabels:
      infraenvs.agent-install.openshift.io: appliance
  pullSecretRef:
    name: appliance-pull-secret
  sshAuthorizedKey: ssh-rsa 
status:
  agentLabelSelector: {}
  bootArtifacts:
    discoveryIgnitionURL: ""
    initrd: ""
    ipxeScript: ""
    kernel: ""
    rootfs: ""
  debugInfo:
    eventsURL: ""
-- expected/cluster-image-set.yaml --
apiVersion: hive.openshift.io/v1
kind: ClusterImageSet
metadata:
  name: openshift-5.0.0-okd-scos.8
spec:
  releaseImage: $RELEASE_IMAGE
status: {}
-- expected/pull-secret.yaml --
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: appliance-pull-secret
stringData:
  .dockerconfigjson: |-
    {
      "auths": {
        "": {
          "auth": "dXNlcjpwYXNz"
        }
      }
    }
-- expected/nmstateconfig.yaml --
apiVersion: agent-install.openshift.io/v1beta1
kind: NMStateConfig
metadata:
  labels:
    infraenvs.agent-install.openshift.io: appliance
  name: nmstate-0
spec:
  config:
    interfaces:
    - ipv4:
        address:
        - ip: 192.168.122.80
          prefix-length: 24
        dhcp: false
        enabled: true
      mac-address: 52:54:00:aa:bb:01
      name: eth0
      state: up
      type: ethernet
  interfaces:
  - macAddress: 52:54:00:aa:bb:01
    name: eth0
---
-- expected/rendezvous-host.env --
(?m)^NODE_ZERO_IP=192\.168\.122\.80$
-- expected/grub.cfg --
.*fips=1.*
